about_the_game:
A Lounge Somewhere is an open-world exploration RPG. You are an ordinary person who unintentionally discovered a seemingly ordinary lounge. Here, you can drink coffee, enjoy snacks, grow flowers, play Gashapons, play the piano, try arcade games, and play various games with the server... No task is mandatory to complete. Everything here is designed to make you feel at home.

  

 

  • Free Exploration

The lounge spans three floors, equipped with various usable facilities and items. You are free to do anything: enjoy coffee and cake at the bar, try making different types of coffee yourself, bake some cookies in the oven, freely adjust the lighting and curtains, change into your favorite pajamas, lie down or nap on the bed, plant your favorite flowers in the planter, or play your favorite music on the piano...

 

  • Focused Work

You can use the lounge's computer to set a focus time and activate Focus Mode. During this period, you can't do anything else—except have the server bring you coffee or snacks. The focus timer has two modes: one requires the game screen to remain open, while the other remains active even if you minimize the window or close the game. When you complete your scheduled work, you'll receive extra rewards.

 

  • You need to use a currency called "Silent Coins" to make purchases.

This doesn't seem to be a real-world currency. However, as long as you are in the lounge, something that can be exchanged for Silent Coins will continuously grow in your pocket. When you focus on work using the lounge's computer, you can earn extra Silent Coins, even if the window is minimized.

 

  • Silence is Golden

You'll need a currency called "Silence Coins" to make purchases. This doesn't appear to be any real-world currency. However, as long as you're inside the lounge, something that can be exchanged for Silence Coins will continuously and quietly grow in your pocket.

 

  • Real-World Time

The time here is completely synchronized with the real world. When night falls in reality, the view outside the windows here will also darken.

 

  • Weather Changes

The weather outside the windows is completely different from the real world. One moment it might be sunny, and the next, strong winds, thunderstorms, or light snow might appear. Fortunately, you can check the daily weather forecast on the TV to prepare yourself for the next hour's weather.

 

  • Retro Arcade

You can play a series of classic mini-games on the lounge's arcade machine: Snake, Brick Breaker, Shoot 'Em Up, Tetris... and even simple drawing and music composition software.

 

  • A server on duty 24/7.

If you're too lazy to make things yourself, you can purchase ready-made drinks and snacks from the server. You can also ask the server to play board games and word games with you, with the difficulty adjusted to your level. Striking up conversations with the server at different times and in varying weather conditions might lead to subtly different topics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1 / 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo (or equivalent AMD processor)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics, supporting DirectX 9.0c
  • Sound Card: Any DirectSound compatible sound card
